description: A CSS gradient generator for linear, radial and conic — copy the code straight out. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

angle.description: Degrees, normalised to 0-359. For linear it is the direction the gradient runs, 0 pointing up and 180 down; for conic it is where the sweep starts. Ignored for radial.

repeating.description: Emit the repeating-* variant, which tiles the gradient over the box instead of stretching it once. Only visible when the stops have explicit positions short of 100.

shape.description: For radial gradients only: 'circle' keeps the rings round, 'ellipse' stretches them to the box. Ignored for linear and conic.

stops.description: The colours in order, from 2 to 16 of them.

colour.description: Any CSS colour: a hex code, rgb(), hsl() or a named colour.

position.description: Where along the gradient this colour sits, as a percentage from 0 to 100. Omit it and CSS spaces the stop evenly between its neighbours.

type.description: The kind of CSS gradient: 'linear' runs in a straight line at the angle, 'radial' spreads out from the centre, 'conic' sweeps round the centre.

name: gradient_generator
title: CSS Gradient Generator
